title: Credit Line Increase Standard for Ridgeline Consumer Credit Cards
content:
**Credit standard — credit line increases.** A credit line increase on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is granted only on the cardholder's own request, recorded as a credit limit increase request carrying the requested credit line.

**Conditions**, each read from the account's records when the increase is decided:

- the account status is active;
- the account has been open for at least the tier's months-open figure in full calendar months since it was opened;
- at least the tier's cooldown in full calendar months has passed since the last credit line change, counted from the date the last change took effect; when the account shows no date of a last change, the line has never changed and the cooldown is met;
- months are counted in whole calendar months: N months are complete on the same day of the month N months later, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist;
- the account carries no late fee dated in the tier's clean-history months — the calendar months ending on the date of the request — leaving out any late fee reversed with the posting error reason.

**New line.** The new line is the lowest of the requested credit line, the current credit line increased by the tier's largest-increase percentage (rounded to the cent), the tier's highest line, and the headroom left under the combined exposure limit, rounded down to the tier's rounding increment. When that figure is not above the current credit line no increase is granted.

**Tiers without increases.** A tier whose largest-increase percentage is 0 — every Ridgeline Project Loan — never receives an increase. An increase never moves the account to another tier, and decreases are made only by the bank.

## Worked new lines (hypothetical; 25 percent largest increase, 100.00 increment)

| Current line | Requested | Tier highest line | Headroom | Lowest of the four | New line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 9000.00 | 9900.00 | 60000.00 | 7500.00 | 7500.00 |
| 9800.00 | 12000.00 | 9900.00 | 60000.00 | 9900.00 | 9900.00 |
| 1150.00 | 2900.00 | 2900.00 | 60000.00 | 1437.50 | rounded down 1400.00 |
| 9900.00 | 11000.00 | 9900.00 | 60000.00 | 9900.00 | not above the current line: no increase |

## Month boundaries (hypothetical, 6 months)

| Anchor | 6 months complete on |
|---|---|
| opened 15 January | 15 July |
| last line change 31 March | 30 September |
